units.source_text: 明石道人今天的送别，实在体面之极！

en.t: The Akashi Monk's farewell today was truly splendid beyond measure!

units.source_text: 凡随从人等，直至最低位的仆役，都受赠珍贵的旅行服装。

en.t: Everyone in the retinue, down to the lowest-ranking servants, received precious traveling clothes as gifts.

units.source_text: 这等体面的赠品，不知道他是什么时候准备好的。

en.t: No one knew when he had prepared such impressive gifts.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的旅行服装自不必说，此外又抬了好几只衣箱来，一并奉赠。

en.t: Needless to say, he provided traveling clothes for Prince Genji, and he also had several clothing chests carried in and presented along with them.

units.source_text: 给他带回京都去的正式礼物，更加丰富多彩，并且用意十分周到。

en.t: The formal gifts for him to take back to Kyoto were even more varied and thoughtfully chosen.

units.source_text: 明石姬在公子今天备用的旅行服装上附一首诗：

en.t: Lady Akashi attached a poem to the traveling clothes prepared for the prince to use that day:
